items.title: [FP] Java: every Map/HashMap/TreeMap.get() is a high-severity `plugin_param` taint source, so constant lookup tables produce flow-backed sql/cmd/path/xss findings
items.summary:
## Defect

`configs/sources/io_sources.yaml` (and the bundled defaults) register `get` on `Map`, `HashMap`, `LinkedHashMap`, `TreeMap`, `ConcurrentHashMap` and `Hashtable` as taint sources: `type: plugin_param`, `severity: high`, `return_tainted: true`, with the note "often used for plugin/config parameters from user input". Nothing checks what was put into the map, so **every** Java map read starts a taint flow, including maps filled only with string literals.
